metric_definitions.peak_rss_bytes: Windows peak_wset high-water mark when available; otherwise maximum 10 ms sampled RSS
metric_definitions.wall_seconds: elapsed wall time for one complete QuadraticEigenSolver.solve call

reference_identity.role: numerical gates only; not an external physical oracle

tolerance_policy.conservative_growth_ratio_definition: max_i(abs(real(lambda_i))/max(omega_ref,abs(lambda_i))) over the complete finite raw spectrum
tolerance_policy.generalized_eigenvalue_condition_definit: for each scaled generalized pencil root, ||left||2*||B*right||2/abs(left.conj().T*B*right); zero denominator or non-finite estimate is rejected
tolerance_policy.normalized_spectral_pair_mismatch_defini: minimum-cost full assignment between raw lambda and conjugate(raw lambda), with cost abs(lambda_i-conj(lambda_j))/max(omega_ref,abs(lambda_i),abs(lambda_j)); report maximum assigned cost
tolerance_policy.positive_definiteness: Cholesky factorization succeeds for each reduced symmetric M and K; no threshold tuning after observing a case
tolerance_policy.symmetry_definition: norm_F(A-A.T)/max(norm_F(A),tiny) for M/K and norm_F(G+G.T)/max(norm_F(G),tiny) for G
